descripcion: KitsuX is a modern open-source anime and manga platform based on Aniyomi, featuring a Netflix-inspired UI, smart recommendations powered by Jikan, dynamic easter eggs, and full extension ecosystem compatibility. Ad-free, privacy-focused, and designed for a seamless user experience.
